pages.text: The pistol holds seventeen. $(bold)Rounds$() go in your pocket first: right-click a handful to pocket them, sneak to pocket the lot. $(bold)R$() reloads from the pocket. The rifle is the same with rifle rounds.$(br)The soldiers and the scavengers carry both kinds; the rooms in town hold pistol rounds.$(br)$(bold)If you die$() you wake in the yard with the pistol, loaded, and this notebook. Everything else lies where you fell.
